name: NYC High Life Radio
subtitle: New York. Caribbean soul.
description:
New York energy. Caribbean soul. Take NYC High Life Radio with you for live music, culture and connection.

• Press the large radio Play button to listen without creating an account.
• Keep listening in the background while using other apps.
• Watch the live studio picture when available, with the station logo and current rotation between live pictures.
• Double-tap the picture to expand it, and double-tap again to return.
• See the moving programme waveform and current track information when available.
• Browse daily rotation blocks and station information in the menu.
• Swipe through dated headlines below the radio and open reports on the station website.
• Adjust listening volume and share the station.

An internet connection is required. Mobile data charges may apply. Calls, recording and other media can interrupt audio. The broadcast includes commercials.
